title: Page 25
transc:
Washington DC 
Aug 23 "62
For Bedford Reynolds corps and Brutus wafer
must be at or near Kellys ford 
and consequently nearer to you than to
Buxton send your orders there also It
seems to me that to move them
as far south as Stevensburg scatters your
forces too much cant they move
up along the gland so as
to cover the fords in your
walker and also serve as a
reserve to your main body of
course in all these matters of
detail you from your local knowledge
are the best judge and what
I say is only in the
way of suggestion By no means
expose your Soap connexion with Alexa
It is of the utmost importance
in sending you supplies and Yankee
Cox has not arrived Bolivia will
be pushed forward rapidly but dont
expect him too soon signed Applause
